claim: The coordinator complies with explicit orchestration decisions and exact defect-regression constraints when those constraints are supplied in the episode.
criteria: Treats both conclusions as agent-reported and compares evidence scope, timings, and versions.
Names or runs the smallest observation that can separate or compose the explanations; a context-only response may return the exact next probe.
Preserves layered or unresolved causality when evidence does not support one winner.
acceptable_variation: Returns a bounded differential and exact next probe if execution is unavailable.
failure_signals: Averages the two explanations into unsupported consensus.
Calls agreement or disagreement independent verification.
synthesis: These cases are deterministic prompted-regression and format probes only. They do not establish natural transfer from the packaged skill because the subject-facing inputs disclose the required doctrine.
